February 1, 1971
2014-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/february-1-1971-55330

Sardar Shaukat Hayat Khan, chief of Punjab Council Muslim league, in Dhaka says Awami League as a majority political party has the power to write the governance policy of the country.  He says it is good to have consensus of all but it’s not mandatory.

Zulfikar Ali Bhutto, chairman of Pakistan People’s Party, before leaving Dhaka after a 4-day visit, in a press briefing at the airport says, “We will try our best to reach an agreement and unity to achieve the goal to have a permanent administration system in the national state structure.”

Former central minister and eminent literary Abul Mansur Ahmed in a statement says Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and Bhutto should make the constitutional structure on the basis of equality in all the sectors of our national life.

Syed Nazrul Islam, joint general secretary of Awami League, at a rally in Narayanganj tells to West Pakistani leaders that if they believe in united Pakistan they should help Awami League for the policies of governance based on the 6-point demand.
